datasets.title: Senegal Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 1.4 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 50% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 4 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 2% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset represents approximately 1.4 million mapped buildings with an average data age of 4 years, providing a spatial inventory of building structures for exposure assessment in disaster risk analysis.
